name: LCD1602 with I2C backpack (PCF8574)
description: An LCD1602 (HD44780, 16 x 2) behind the common I2C backpack, on its 4-pin header: GND, VCC, SDA, SCL. The PCF8574 answers its address (0x27 by default, 0x20-0x27, or 0x38-0x3F for a PCF8574A) and drives the LCD from its port: P0 RS, P1 R/W, P2 E, P3 the backlight, P4-P7 D4-D7, so the LCD is used in 4-bit mode; reading the port returns what the LCD drives on D4-D7 during a read cycle (busy flag). The backpack holds SDA and SCL high through its pull-ups. The controller has the timings of the lcd1602 (early, timing); the trimmer sets the contrast. The module draws no current from the circuit.

color.description: Dark characters on a yellow-green panel, or white characters on a blue one.

address.description: 7-bit I2C address of the PCF8574 (A0-A2 jumpers): 0x20-0x27 (32-39), or 0x38-0x3F (56-63) for a PCF8574A.

footprint.description: The 4 pins of the backpack header, 2.54 mm apart, in one row.

powered.description: VCC is at least 2.7 V above GND.

contrast.description: How dark the dots that are on look, from the trimmer of the backpack: 0 below 3 V between VCC and V0, 1 from 4.5 V.

backlight.description: The backlight, switched by P3 of the PCF8574 (the jumper of the backpack in place).

displayOn.description: The display is on (display control D).

cursor.description: The underline cursor is shown (display control C).

blink.description: The character at the cursor blinks (display control B).

dataBits.description: Width of the interface: 8, or 4 after a function set with DL clear.

lines.description: Display lines of the function set: 1 after power on, 2 with N set.

dataWrites.description: Characters or CGRAM rows written since power on.

reads.description: Reads of the busy flag or of the memory.

early.description: Writes lost because the controller was still busy, and memory reads while it was.

timing.description: E pulses shorter than 230 ns, or less than 500 ns after the previous one.

revision.description: Increases whenever what the panel shows may have changed.

trimmer.description: Position of the contrast trimmer of the backpack: V0 from GND (0) to VCC (1).

port.description: The state written to P0-P7 of the PCF8574: P0 RS, P1 R/W, P2 E, P3 backlight, P4-P7 D4-D7.

i2cWrites.description: Bytes the master wrote to the PCF8574.

i2cReads.description: Bytes the PCF8574 sent to the master.
